ctx.x: ...(?)... The highest element... I mean, the most predominant artist in that respect would have been the late Virgil Fox, who received...who played these Classical numbers, and you'd see his feet going like hands. That's something to see. To show you how you can develop that technique, to what extent; you know, how to get there. But in Jazz you just cannot keep that rhythm going that way with your feet. Well, I mean, it can be mastered as much as you have... If you can help it with your hands, you have much…
Now, the bass of the Hammond, that didn't record well, did it?
